data.title: Rubik's Cube stickers
data.solution:
class Rubik :
    def __init__(self, tab) :
        self.U = [list(tab[i]) for i in range(3)]           # Up
        self.F = [list(tab[i][0:3]) for i in range(4,7)]    # Front
        self.R = [list(tab[i][4:7]) for i in range(4,7)]    # Right
        self.B = [list(tab[i][8:11]) for i in range(4,7)]   # Back
        self.L = [list(tab[i][12:15]) for i in range(4,7)]  # Left
        self.D = [list(tab[i]) for i in range(8,11)]        # Down
    def __repr__(self) :
        chaine = "\n".join(["".join(self.U[i]) for i in range(3)])
        chaine += "\n" + "---" + "\n"
        chaine += "\n".join(["".join(self.F[i]) + "|" + "".join(self.R[i]) + "|" + "".join(self.B[i]) + "|" + "".join(self.L[i]) for i in range(3)])
        chaine += "\n" + "---" + "\n"
        chaine += "\n".join(["".join(self.D[i]) for i in range(3)])
        return chaine
    def extraire_centres(self) :
        """
        Récupération des étiquettes des centres
        """
        tab = [self.U[1][1], self.F[1][1], self.R[1][1], self.B[1][1], self.L[1][1], self.D[1][1]]
        return tab
    def injecter_centres(self, tab) :
        """
        Mise à jour des étiquettes des centres
        """
        self.U[1][1], self.F[1][1], self.R[1][1], self.B[1][1], self.L[1][1], self.D[1][1] = tab
    def completer_centres(self, couleurs) :
        """
        Recollage des étiquettes manquantes des centres
        """
        ordres_possibles = []
        c_U = couleurs
        for i in range(4) :
            ordres_possibles.append([c_U[0]] + c_U[1+i:5] + c_U[1:1+i] + [c_U[5]])
        c_L = [couleurs[1], couleurs[5], couleurs[2], couleurs[0], couleurs[4], couleurs[3]]
        for i in range(4) :
            ordres_possibles.append([c_L[0]] + c_L[1+i:5] + c_L[1:1+i] + [c_L[5]])
        c_F = [couleurs[2], couleurs[1], couleurs[5], couleurs[3], couleurs[0], couleurs[4]]
        for i in range(4) :
            ordres_possibles.append([c_F[0]] + c_F[1+i:5] + c_F[1:1+i] + [c_F[5]])
        c_R = [couleurs[3], couleurs[0], couleurs[2], couleurs[5], couleurs[4], couleurs[1]]
        for i in range(4) :
            ordres_possibles.append([c_R[0]] + c_R[1+i:5] + c_R[1:1+i] + [c_R[5]])
        c_B = [couleurs[4], couleurs[1], couleurs[0], couleurs[3], couleurs[5], couleurs[2]]
        for i in range(4) :
            ordres_possibles.append([c_B[0]] + c_B[1+i:5] + c_B[1:1+i] + [c_B[5]])
        c_D = [couleurs[5], couleurs[1], couleurs[4], couleurs[3], couleurs[2], couleurs[0]]
        for i in range(4) :
            ordres_possibles.append([c_D[0]] + c_D[1+i:5] + c_D[1:1+i] + [c_D[5]])
        centres = self.extraire_centres()
        for ordre in ordres_possibles :
            ok = True
            for c1, c2 in zip(centres, ordre) :
                if c1 != "." and c1 != c2 :
                    ok = False
                    break
            if ok :
                break
        centres = [c for c in ordre]
        self.injecter_centres(centres)
    def extraire_cotes(self) :
        """
        Récupération des étiquettes des côtés
        """
        tab = []
        tab.append((self.U[0][1], self.B[0][1]))
        tab.append((self.U[1][0], self.L[0][1]))
        tab.append((self.U[1][2], self.R[0][1]))
        tab.append((self.U[2][1], self.F[0][1]))
        tab.append((self.L[1][0], self.B[1][2]))
        tab.append((self.L[1][2], self.F[1][0]))
        tab.append((self.R[1][0], self.F[1][2]))
        tab.append((self.R[1][2], self.B[1][0]))
        tab.append((self.D[0][1], self.F[2][1]))
        tab.append((self.D[1][0], self.L[2][1]))
        tab.append((self.D[1][2], self.R[2][1]))
        tab.append((self.D[2][1], self.B[2][1]))
        return tab
    def injecter_cotes(self, tab) :
        """
        Mise à jour des étiquettes des côtés
        """
        self.U[0][1], self.B[0][1] = tab[0]
        self.U[1][0], self.L[0][1] = tab[1]
        self.U[1][2], self.R[0][1] = tab[2]
        self.U[2][1], self.F[0][1] = tab[3]
        self.L[1][0], self.B[1][2] = tab[4]
        self.L[1][2], self.F[1][0] = tab[5]
        self.R[1][0], self.F[1][2] = tab[6]
        self.R[1][2], self.B[1][0] = tab[7]
        self.D[0][1], self.F[2][1] = tab[8]
        self.D[1][0], self.L[2][1] = tab[9]
        self.D[1][2], self.R[2][1] = tab[10]
        self.D[2][1], self.B[2][1] = tab[11]
    def completer_cotes(self, resolu_2c) :
        """
        Recollage des étiquettes manquantes des côtés
        """
        tab_2c = self.extraire_cotes()
        a_trouver = []
        for i, (c1,c2) in enumerate(tab_2c) :
            if c1 != "." and c2 != "." :
                if (c1,c2) in resolu_2c :
                    resolu_2c.remove((c1,c2))
                else :
                    resolu_2c.remove((c2,c1))
            else :
                a_trouver.append(i)
        while a_trouver :
            for i in a_trouver :
                (c1,c2) = tab_2c[i]
                possible = []
                for (c3,c4) in resolu_2c :
                    if c1 != "." and c1 == c3 or c1 == c4 :
                        possible.append((c3,c4))
                    elif c2 != "." and c2 == c3 or c2 == c4 :
                        possible.append((c3,c4))
                if len(possible) == 1 :
                    break
            else :
                print(">>> BUG ! (2)")
            a_trouver.remove(i)
            (c3, c4) = possible.pop()
            resolu_2c.remove((c3,c4))
            if c1 != "." :
                if c1 == c3 :
                    tab_2c[i] = (c1, c4)
                else :
                    tab_2c[i] = (c1, c3)
            else :
                if c2 == c3 :
                    tab_2c[i] = (c4, c2)
                else :
                    tab_2c[i] = (c3, c2)
        self.injecter_cotes(tab_2c)
    def extraire_coins(self) :
        """
        Récupération des étiquettes des coins
        """
        tab = []
        tab.append((self.U[0][0], self.B[0][2], self.L[0][0]))
        tab.append((self.U[0][2], self.R[0][2], self.B[0][0]))
        tab.append((self.U[2][0], self.L[0][2], self.F[0][0]))
        tab.append((self.U[2][2], self.F[0][2], self.R[0][0]))
        tab.append((self.D[0][0], self.F[2][0], self.L[2][2]))
        tab.append((self.D[0][2], self.R[2][0], self.F[2][2]))
        tab.append((self.D[2][0], self.L[2][0], self.B[2][2]))
        tab.append((self.D[2][2], self.B[2][0], self.R[2][2]))
        return tab
    def injecter_coins(self, tab) :
        """
        Mise à jour des étiquettes des coins
        """
        self.U[0][0], self.B[0][2], self.L[0][0] = tab[0]
        self.U[0][2], self.R[0][2], self.B[0][0] = tab[1]
        self.U[2][0], self.L[0][2], self.F[0][0] = tab[2]
        self.U[2][2], self.F[0][2], self.R[0][0] = tab[3]
        self.D[0][0], self.F[2][0], self.L[2][2] = tab[4]
        self.D[0][2], self.R[2][0], self.F[2][2] = tab[5]
        self.D[2][0], self.L[2][0], self.B[2][2] = tab[6]
        self.D[2][2], self.B[2][0], self.R[2][2] = tab[7]
    def completer_coins(self, resolu_3c) :
        """
        Recollage des étiquettes manquantes des coins
        """
        def compatible(c1,c2,c3,c4,c5,c6) :
            if c1 != "." and c1 != c4 :
                return False
            if c2 != "." and c2 != c5 :
                return False
            if c3 != "." and c3 != c6 :
                return False
            return True
        tab_3c = self.extraire_coins()
        a_trouver = []
        for i, (c1,c2,c3) in enumerate(tab_3c) :
            if c1 != "." and c2 != "." and c3 != "." :
                if (c1,c2,c3) in resolu_3c :
                    resolu_3c.remove((c1,c2,c3))
                elif (c2,c3,c1) in resolu_3c :
                    resolu_3c.remove((c2,c3,c1))
                else :
                    resolu_3c.remove((c3,c1,c2))
            else :
                a_trouver.append(i)
        while a_trouver :
            for i in a_trouver :
                (c1,c2,c3) = tab_3c[i]
                possible = []
                for (c4,c5,c6) in resolu_3c :
                    if compatible(c1,c2,c3,c4,c5,c6) :
                        possible.append((c4,c5,c6))
                    elif compatible(c1,c2,c3,c5,c6,c4) :
                        possible.append((c5,c6,c4))
                    elif compatible(c1,c2,c3,c6,c4,c5) :
                        possible.append((c6,c4,c5))
                if len(possible) == 1 :
                    break
            else :
                print(">>> BUG ! (3)")
            a_trouver.remove(i)
            (c1,c2,c3) = possible.pop()
            if (c1,c2,c3) in resolu_3c :
                resolu_3c.remove((c1,c2,c3))
            elif (c2,c3,c1) in resolu_3c :
                resolu_3c.remove((c2,c3,c1))
            else :
                resolu_3c.remove((c3,c1,c2))
            tab_3c[i] = (c1,c2,c3)
        self.injecter_coins(tab_3c)
    def completer_cube(self, couleurs) :
        """
        Recollage de toutes les étiquettes manquantes du cube
        """
        self.completer_centres(couleurs)
        #
        tab_resolu = []
        for i in range(3) :
            tab_resolu.append(3*couleurs[0])
        tab_resolu.append("---")
        for i in range(3) :
            tab_resolu.append("|".join([3*couleurs[1+j] for j in range(4)]))  
        tab_resolu.append("---")
        for i in range(3) :
            tab_resolu.append(3*couleurs[5])   
        cube_resolu = Rubik(tab_resolu)
        #
        resolu_2c = cube_resolu.extraire_cotes()
        self.completer_cotes(resolu_2c)
        #
        resolu_3c = cube_resolu.extraire_coins()
        self.completer_coins(resolu_3c)

couleurs = input().split()
tab = []
for i in range(11) :
    tab.append(input())
cube = Rubik(tab)
cube.completer_cube(couleurs)
print(cube)

Your Rubik's Cube is scrambled and some of the stickers have come off!

You still don't know how to solve a Rubik's Cube, but you'd like to stick the stickers back on correctly so that when you finally learn how, it will still be possible...

The order of the colors of the solved cube is given in the first row.
For example, W G R B O Y means :
`
WWW
WWW
WWW
---
GGG|RRR|BBB|OOO
GGG|RRR|BBB|OOO
GGG|RRR|BBB|OOO
---
YYY
YYY
YYY
`
Note: In a Rubik's Cube, the centers are linked; their order cannot be changed...

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Your Rubik's Cube is scrambled and some of the stickers have come off!

You still don't know how to solve a Rubik's Cube, but you'd like to stick the stickers back on correctly so that when you finally learn how, it will still be possible...

The order of the colors of the solved cube is given in the first row.
For example, W G R B O Y means :

WWW
WWW
WWW
---
GGG|RRR|BBB|OOO
GGG|RRR|BBB|OOO
GGG|RRR|BBB|OOO
---
YYY
YYY
YYY

Note: In a Rubik's Cube, the centers are linked; their order cannot be changed...
Input
Line 1 : 6 characters U F R B L D, separated by spaces, representing the colors of the Cube's faces in order: Up, Front, Right, Back, Left, Down.

11 following lines : the colors of the stickers for each of the 27 small squares of the Rubik's Cube with a "." for the stickers that have been removed.
Output
11 lines : the colors of the stickers for each of the 27 small squares of the Rubik's Cube. (The Cube must not have rotated.)
Constraints
Example
Input
W G R B O Y
ORO
ROR
ORO
---
WYW|BGB|YWY|GBG
YWY|GBG|WYW|B.B
WYW|BGB|YWY|GBG
---
ROR
ORO
ROR
Output
ORO
ROR
ORO
---
WYW|BGB|YWY|GBG
YWY|GBG|WYW|BGB
WYW|BGB|YWY|GBG
---
ROR
ORO
ROR
